t: What Does The Name Jawana Mean?
s: Across languages and regions, related forms include Joanna and Joanne (English), Johanna (German/Scandinavian/Dutch), Ivana (Slavic), Giovanna (Italian), Juana (Spanish), Joana (Portuguese/Catalan), and Siobhán (Irish, from Joan). Phonetic or orthographic cousins such as Jowana, Juwana, and Jawanna appear in English-language records, while in Arabic contexts the visually similar but etymologically distinct Jowan/Jawān (often interpreted as “youth”) sometimes overlaps in usage.
